title: Backend resource
description: Contract, Drizzle table and Nest lib (module, service, controller) of a resource.

name.description: Resource name, singular or plural (e.g. invoice).

fields.description: Fields of the new table, as name:type[:option…] (e.g. status:enum:values=draft|sent:required). `dafne g backend-resource` asks for them.

idType.description: Type of the id: serial (picked by the database), uuid (random, picked by the database) or varchar (random, picked by Drizzle).

idLength.description: Length of a varchar id (default 36): from 36 it holds a uuid, below a shorter random hex id.

app.description: Backend app the lib is registered in (apps/<app>).

lib.description: Existing backend lib the module goes into (packages/backend/<lib>/src/<plural>, e.g. sales-order-types in sales-orders). Default: a lib of its own, packages/backend/<plural>. `dafne g backend-resource` asks for it.
